reg.subject: You are In! Registration Confirmed for {workshop_title}
reg.body:
Dear {student_name},

Thank you for your interest in the Agentic AI Application Development – Short Course organized by the Institute of Computer Engineering Technology (iCET) Trainings. Learn how to build intelligent AI agents through practical, real-world hands-on projects!

Please find the course schedule, pricing details, and event information below.

Course & Schedule Details

📅 Dates: Every Sunday | Oct 4, Oct 11, Oct 18, Oct 25 (4 Days)
🕐 Time & Duration: 9:00 AM onwards (16 Total Hours)
📍 Venue: Institute of Computer Engineering Technology,
223A Galle Road, Panadura
💻 Delivery Mode: Physical Hands-on Sessions

Resource Person

Mr. Dewmal Handapangoda
AI Architect
Founder, Syigen Private Limited
Founder, Art of Intelligence
MSc in AI, University of Moratuwa
BSc, University of Peradeniya

What You Will Learn

  • Planning: Architecting autonomous AI agent workflows and task execution
  • Tool Calling: Integrating external tools, APIs, and services with AI agents
  • Guardrails: Ensuring safety, validation, and control mechanisms in AI behaviors
  • RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation): Connecting agents to dynamic external knowledge bases
  • Building real-world Agentic AI projects from scratch

Important Reminders

  • Please bring your laptop to participate in hands-on demonstrations and project building.
  • Please arrive at least 15 minutes early on the first day for registration and seating.
  • All participants will receive an official iCET Professional Certificate upon completion.

For more details, future updates, and to join similar programs, follow us on our socials:

  • Join the iCET Official WhatsApp Channel: Click Here
  • iCET Institute Official LinkedIn Page: Click Here

If you have any questions before the event or need assistance with your registration, feel free to reach out to us by replying to this email.

We look forward to seeing you at the course!

Best regards,
iCET Professional Development Unit
Institute of Computer Engineering Technology (Pvt) Ltd.

223 A, Galle Rd, Panadura 12500
Tel: 070 5 805 805 | Web: www.icet.lk | Email: pdu@icet.lk

student_registration_form_mandatory.label: Student Registration Form (Mandatory)
student_registration_form_mandatory.help:
Download and complete the Student Registration Form, then upload the completed form. (PDF format only)
📄 Student Registration Form – Download the Application Form

course_offer_letter_mandatory.label: Course Offer Letter (Mandatory)
course_offer_letter_mandatory.help:
The Course Offer Letter is provided by your counsellor at the time of registration.If you have not received this document, please contact your counsellor and obtain it.
You are required to sign the Course Offer Letter and upload the completed document in PDF format only.

scan_copy_of_the_gce_ol_certificate_pdf_.label: Scan Copy of the G.C.E. (O/L) Certificate (PDF format only)

scan_copy_of_the_gce_al_certificate_if_y.label: Scan Copy of the G.C.E. (A/L) Certificate ( If you have not completed A/L, please contact the Academic Department at +94 71 829 4989) (PDF format only)

photo_of_your_nic_both_sides.label: Photo of your NIC (Both Sides)
photo_of_your_nic_both_sides.help: This photo should be less than 10MB in size and must be clear

scan_copy_of_birth_certificate_pdf_forma.label: Scan Copy of Birth Certificate (PDF format only)

name_to_appear_on_the_certificate_only_3.label: Name To Appear On The Certificate (Only 35 characters with spaces)

your_preferred_name_for_only_two_names.label: Your Preferred Name for (Only two names)

whatsapp_number.label: WhatsApp Number
whatsapp_number.help: Please note that this number will be added to the WhatsApp group of your batch. This number cannot be changed once added. Therefore, kindly check whether the number you've provided is correct.

google_email_address.label: Google Email Address
google_email_address.help:
Access to all program resources will only be granted to the email that you provide here and this email will be added to the Learning Management System.
NOTE: The email address you provide must be a Gmail account. Please be aware that once the form is submitted, the email address cannot be changed, under any circumstances. Therefore, enter your correct email address after double-checking.

education_level.label: Education Level
education_level.help: Please select your higher educational qualification. If it is not in the list, kindy mention it in the "Other" field.

what_is_your_purpose_of_following_this_p.label: What is your purpose of following this Program?
options: To find a career in the Software Industry
To do free lance projects and start earning
To start your own software company (Entrepreneur)

gce_advanced_level_examination_year.label: G.C.E. Advanced Level Examination Year
gce_advanced_level_examination_year.help: If you are not undertaking your Advanced Level (A/L) examinations, please state "Not participating in A/L examination."

mother_father_guardian_contact_number.label: Mother / Father / Guardian Contact Number
mother_father_guardian_contact_number.help: This cannot be the same as your contact number provided above.

portrait_photo_max_10mb.label: Portrait Photo (Max. 10MB)
portrait_photo_max_10mb.help: This photo should be less than 10MB in size and a clear portrait image of you. (DON'T upload selfies, group photos or your ID card photo)
